crossRefs.note: For I am with you, says Yahweh, to save you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have scattered you…
Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.

translations.web: Yahweh, correct me, but gently; not in your anger, lest you reduce me to nothing.
translations.bsb: Correct me, O LORD, but only with justice— not in Your anger, or You will bring me to nothing.
translations.kjv: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.
translations.asv: O Jehovah, correct me, but in measure: not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.
